texts.orig: Something of a paradox, too; highly competitive but approachable; stylish but never a slave to fashion. I have a true talent for leadership. I'm  stable,  steady,  reliable,  and  efficient.  At the same time, I'm good-looking, good-natured, and good-humored. Seek successful business person driven by values, with a 'whatever it takes' attitude - just like me, practical and professional.
